title: Self-review of the three representative workflows from an independent installation, replacing the independent-user test by owner decision
owner_decision: 24 September 2026: the independent-user test is skipped; the maintainer's agent runs the self-review below instead

workflows: the G7 small finite metalens workflow
fixture.installation: a fresh virtual environment outside the checkout with the release wheel installed by pip; no source tree on sys.path
fixture.instructions: only README.md and the documents it links; no knowledge of the source code is used to work around a documentation gap
fixture.record: docs/validation/g9-05-self-review.json: per workflow the commands followed, the outcome, the wall time and every issue found (documentation gap, error message, wrong default, missing step) with its resolution or an open-issue entry

seed: the seeds of the G7 workflows
precision: as documented for each G7 workflow
backend: cuda on rtx3060-win11-lab, and the CPU path where a workflow documents one
reference_method: the documented expected outputs of each G7 workflow

observables.name: workflows_completed
observables.definition: G7 workflows that complete from the installed wheel by following the documentation alone

observables.name: issues_found
observables.definition: every issue met during the self-review, each with a fix commit or an open-issue entry

acceptance.independent_user: the program's independent-user test is declared not applicable by the owner's decision of 24 September 2026; this self-review replaces it and is not evidence of usability by another person
acceptance.issues: every entry of issues_found has a fix commit or an open-issue entry; none is silently dropped
acceptance.precondition: the three G7 workflows are VERIFIED before the self-review runs
acceptance.source_of_limits: G9-05 in docs/COMPLETION_PROGRAM_KO.md, narrowed by the owner decision above
